variants.headline: Still in view: people leave the colony on the ship
variants.sub: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home.
variants.body:
People have left the colony on the ship: young adults without work and families without homes. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

Labour's question is not whether a person ought to love the colony enough to endure anything. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
